units.zh: 仁自兩漢以來，外戚之家罕有全者，其傾覆之跡，逆亂之機，皆詳諸前史。
units.en: Since the Han dynasties, few consort clans have survived unscathed—their falls and the seeds of rebellion are fully recorded in earlier histories.
units.literal: Since the Two Han dynasties, few households of imperial affines have been preserved intact; the traces of their ruin and the occasions of rebellion and disorder are all set forth in detail in the earlier histories.

units.zh: 齊氏后妃之族，多自保全，唯胡長仁以譖訴貽禍，斛律光以地勢被戮，俱非女謁盛衰之所致也。
units.en: Among Northern Qi empresses’ kin, many kept themselves safe; only Hu Changren fell to denunciation, and Hulu Guang was killed for his territorial power—neither owed simply to the waxing and waning of palace women.
units.literal: Among the clans of Qi consorts and empresses, many preserved themselves; only Hu Changren suffered disaster through slander and accusation, and Hulu Guang was executed because of his territorial power—neither was caused by the rise and fall of women’s influence at court.

units.zh: 今依前代史官，述《外戚》云爾。
units.en: Following earlier historians, I here present the account of Imperial Affines.
units.literal: Now, following the historians of former ages, I set forth the “Imperial Affines” as follows.

units.zh: 趙猛，太安狄那人。
units.en: Zhao Meng was from Di in Tai’an.
units.literal: Zhao Meng was a native of Di in Tai’an.

units.zh: 姊為文穆皇帝繼室，生趙郡王琛。
units.en: His elder sister was Emperor Wenmu’s successor consort and bore Zhao Commandery Prince Chen.
units.literal: His elder sister was the successor consort of Emperor Wenmu and bore Prince of Zhao Commandery Chen.

units.zh: 猛性方直，頗有器幹。
units.en: Meng was upright and capable.
units.literal: Meng was upright by nature and possessed considerable ability.

units.zh: 高祖舉義，遷南營州刺史，卒。
units.en: When Gaozu rose in arms, Meng was made inspector of South Ying Province, where he died in office.
units.literal: When Emperor Gaozu raised the righteous standard, Meng was transferred to be Inspector of South Ying Province and died in office.

units.zh: 婁叡，字佛仁，武明皇後兄子也。
units.en: Lou Rui, styled Foren, was a nephew of Empress Wuming.
units.literal: Lou Rui, courtesy name Foren, was a nephew of Empress Wuming.

units.zh: 父壯，魏南部尚書。
units.en: His father Zhuang served Wei as Minister of the Southern Department.
units.literal: His father Zhuang was Minister of the Southern Department in Wei.

units.zh: 叡少好弓馬，有武幹，為高祖帳內都督。
units.en: In youth Rui loved archery and horsemanship, showed martial talent, and served in Gaozu’s personal guard.
units.literal: Rui in youth loved bow and horse, had martial ability, and served as a commander in Gaozu’s personal guard.

units.zh: 從破尒朱於韓陵，累遷開府儀同、驃騎大將軍。
units.en: He fought at Hanling in the defeat of the Erzhu and rose through the ranks to Director of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels and General of Cavalry with Rapid Steeds.
units.literal: He followed in the defeat of the Erzhu at Hanling and was repeatedly promoted to Director of the Bureau of Ceremonial Parallels and General of Cavalry with Rapid Steeds.

units.zh: 叡無器幹，唯以外戚貴幸，而縱情財色，為時論所鄙。
units.en: Rui had little talent and owed his rank only to kinship with the throne; he squandered himself on wealth and women, and contemporaries held him in contempt.
units.literal: Rui lacked ability and relied solely on his status as an imperial affine for favor; he indulged wealth and women and was despised by contemporary opinion.

units.zh: 皇建初，封東安王。
units.en: At the opening of Huangjian he was made Prince of Dong’an.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Huangjian era, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Dong’an.

units.zh: 高歸彥反於冀州，詔叡往平之。
units.en: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, Rui was ordered to suppress him.
units.literal: When Gao Guiyan rebelled in Ji Province, an edict ordered Rui to go and pacify him.

units.zh: 還，拜司徒公。
units.en: On his return he was appointed director of the Department of State.
units.literal: On his return he was appointed Director of the Department of State.

units.zh: 周兵寇東關，叡率軍赴援，頻戰有功，擒周將楊檦等。
units.en: When Zhou troops threatened the eastern passes, Rui marched to their relief, won repeated victories, and captured the Zhou general Yang Biao and others.
units.literal: When Zhou forces raided the eastern passes, Rui led troops to relieve them, fought repeatedly with merit, and captured the Zhou general Yang Biao and others.

units.zh: 進大司馬，出總偏師，赴懸瓠。
units.en: Promoted to grand marshal, he took a detached command at Xuanhu.
units.literal: He was advanced to Grand Marshal and went out to command a detached force at Xuanhu.

units.zh: 叡在豫境，留停百餘日，侵削官私，專行非法，坐免官。
units.en: Rui lingered in Yu more than a hundred days, plundering public and private goods and acting with impunity, until he was dismissed.
units.literal: Rui remained in the Yu region more than a hundred days, encroaching on public and private property and acting lawlessly on his own authority; for this he was removed from office.

units.zh: 尋授太尉。
units.en: He was soon appointed grand commandant.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Grand Commandant.

units.zh: 薨。
units.en: He died in office.
units.literal: He died.

units.zh: 尒朱文暢，榮第四子也。
units.en: Erzhu Wenchang was Erzhu Rong’s fourth son.
units.literal: Erzhu Wenchang was the fourth son of Rong.

units.zh: 初封昌樂王。
units.en: He was first enfeoffed prince of Changle.
units.literal: He was first enfeoffed as Prince of Changle.

units.zh: 其姊魏孝莊皇後，及四胡敗滅，高祖納之，待其家甚厚，文暢由是拜肆州刺史。
units.en: His sister had been Empress Xiaozhuang of Wei; after the Erzhu were overthrown, Gaozu married her and treated her kin lavishly, and Wenchang became inspector of Si Province.
units.literal: His elder sister was Empress of Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei; after the four Erzhu were destroyed, Gaozu took her in marriage and treated her family very generously, and Wenchang was therefore appointed Inspector of Si Province.

units.zh: 家富於財，招致賓客，既籍門地，窮極豪侈，與丞相司馬任胄、主簿李世林、都督鄭仲禮、房子遠等深相愛狎，外示杯酒之交，而潛謀逆亂。
units.en: Rich and hospitable, he leaned on his birth to live in extreme splendor. With Ren Zhou, Li Shilin, Zheng Zhongli, and Fang Ziyuan he feigned convivial friendship while secretly plotting revolt.
units.literal: His household was rich in wealth and he gathered guests; relying on his lineage, he pursued luxury to the utmost. With the chief minister’s aide Ren Zhou, registrar Li Shilin, commander Zheng Zhongli, and Fang Ziyuan he was deeply intimate—outwardly they showed the friendship of wine cups, yet secretly they plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 自魏氏舊俗，以正月十五日夜為打竹簇之戲，有能中者，即時賞帛。
units.en: By Wei custom, on the fifteenth night of the first month people played at striking bamboo targets; a hit won silk on the spot.
units.literal: By the old custom of Wei, on the night of the fifteenth day of the first month there was a game of striking bamboo clusters; whoever hit the mark received silk rewards on the spot.

units.zh: 任胄令仲禮藏刀於袴中，因高祖臨觀，謀為竊發，事捷之後，共奉文暢為主。
units.en: Ren Zhou hid a blade in Zhongli’s trousers; when Gaozu came to watch, they meant to strike—and if they succeeded, to set Wenchang on the throne.
units.literal: Ren Zhou had Zhongli hide a knife in his trousers; when Gaozu came to watch, they planned a sudden attack, and if the affair succeeded they would together install Wenchang as ruler.

units.zh: 為任氏家客薛季孝告高祖，問皆具伏。
units.en: Ren’s retainer Xue Jixiao exposed them to Gaozu, and under questioning all confessed.
units.literal: A retainer of the Ren household, Xue Jixiao, informed Gaozu; on interrogation all confessed.

units.zh: 以其姊寵故，止坐文暢一房。
units.en: Thanks to his sister’s favor, only Wenchang’s own household was punished.
units.literal: Because of his sister’s favor, punishment was limited to Wenchang’s household alone.

units.zh: 弟文略，以兄文羅卒無後，襲梁郡王。
units.en: Younger brother Wenlüe inherited the Liang Commandery princedom when Wenluo died heirless.
units.literal: His younger brother Wenlüe, because his elder brother Wenluo died without heirs, inherited the title Prince of Liang Commandery.

units.zh: 以文暢事，當從坐，高祖特加寬貸。
units.en: He should have shared Wenchang’s guilt, but Gaozu spared him.
units.literal: Because of Wenchang’s affair he should have been punished as an associate, but Gaozu specially granted him leniency.

units.zh: 文略聰明儁爽，多所通習。
units.en: Wenlüe was brilliant, quick-witted, and accomplished in many arts.
units.literal: Wenlüe was clever, sharp, and widely accomplished in many arts.

units.zh: 世宗嘗令章永興於馬上彈胡琵琶，奏十餘曲，試使文略寫之，遂得其八。
units.en: Shizong once had Zhang Yongxing play the pipa on horseback through more than ten pieces and asked Wenlüe to write them down; he caught eight.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong once had Zhang Yongxing play the foreign pipa on horseback and perform more than ten pieces; he had Wenlüe transcribe them, and Wenlüe got eight correct.

units.zh: 世宗戲之曰：「聰明人多不老壽，梁郡其慎之。」
units.en: The emperor teased him: “Clever men seldom live long—take care, Prince of Liang.”
units.literal: The emperor jested, “Clever men often do not live long; Prince of Liang, take care.”

units.zh: 文略對曰：「命之修短，皆在明公。」
units.en: Wenlüe answered, “Long life or short is entirely for Your Majesty to decide.”
units.literal: Wenlüe replied, “Whether life is long or short is all in Your Majesty’s hands.”

units.zh: 世宗愴然曰：「此不足慮也。」
units.en: The emperor said, moved, “That is nothing to worry about.”
units.literal: The emperor said sadly, “That is nothing to worry over.”

units.zh: 初，高祖遺令恕文略十死，恃此益橫，多所淩忽。
units.en: Gaozu’s will had granted Wenlüe ten stays of execution; emboldened, he grew ever more insolent.
units.literal: Earlier, Gaozu’s testament had pardoned Wenlüe ten capital offenses; relying on this he grew ever more overbearing and often insulted others.

units.zh: 平秦王有七百里馬，文略敵以好婢，賭而取之。
units.en: Prince Pingqin owned a horse said to run seven hundred li in a day; Wenlüe wagered a fine maid against it and won.
units.literal: The Prince of Pingqin owned a horse worth seven hundred li; Wenlüe matched it against a fine maidservant, gambled, and won it.

units.zh: 明日，平秦致請，文略殺馬及婢，以二銀器盛婢頭馬肉而遺之。
units.en: When Pingqin came to claim his stake, Wenlüe slaughtered horse and maid and sent back their flesh and her head in silver dishes.
units.literal: The next day the Prince of Pingqin came to redeem the stake; Wenlüe killed the horse and the maid and sent him the maid’s head and the horse’s flesh in two silver vessels.

units.zh: 平秦王訴之於文宣，系於京畿獄。
units.en: Pingqin appealed to Wenxuan, and Wenlüe was thrown into the metropolitan prison.
units.literal: The Prince of Pingqin complained to Emperor Wenxuan, and Wenlüe was imprisoned in the capital jail.

units.zh: 文略彈琵琶，吹橫笛，謠詠，倦極便臥唱挽歌。
units.en: In prison he played pipa and flute, sang songs, and when tired would lie down and chant dirges.
units.literal: Wenlüe played pipa and blew the transverse flute, sang ballads, and when weary would lie down and intone dirges.

units.zh: 居數月，奪防者弓矢以射人曰：「不然，天子不憶我。」
units.en: After months in custody he seized his guards’ bow and shot at people, crying, “Otherwise the emperor would never think of me.”
units.literal: After several months he seized his guards’ bow and arrows and shot at people, saying, “Otherwise the Son of Heaven would not remember me.”

units.zh: 有司奏之，伏法。
units.en: Officials reported him, and he was put to death.
units.literal: The authorities reported this, and he was executed.

units.zh: 文略嘗大遺魏收金，請為其父作佳傳，收論尒朱榮比韋、彭、伊、霍，蓋由是也。
units.en: Wenlüe once paid Wei Shou heavily to glorify his father in print—hence Shou’s likening of Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang.
units.literal: Wenlüe once gave Wei Shou a large gift of gold and asked him to write a fine biography of his father; that Wei Shou compared Erzhu Rong to Wei Qing, Peng Yue, Yi Yin, and Huo Guang was largely for this reason.

units.zh: 鄭仲禮，滎陽開封人，魏鴻臚嚴庶子也。
units.en: Zheng Zhongli was from Kaifeng in Xingyang, son of Yan, Wei’s director of ceremonial.
units.literal: Zheng Zhongli was a native of Kaifeng in Xingyang; he was the son of Yan, Director of Ceremonial of Wei.

units.zh: 少輕險，有膂力，高祖嬖寵其姊，以親戚被昵，擢帳內都督。
units.en: Young and reckless, strong of body, he rose through Gaozu’s fondness for his sister to a post in the personal guard.
units.literal: In youth he was reckless and had physical strength; Gaozu favored his elder sister, and as a kinsman he was treated with intimacy and promoted to commander in the personal guard.

units.zh: 嘗執高祖弓刀，出入隨從。
units.en: He even bore Gaozu’s bow and sword and attended him everywhere.
units.literal: He once carried Gaozu’s bow and blade and attended him in and out.

units.zh: 任胄為好酒不憂公事，高祖責之，胄懼，謀為逆。
units.en: Ren Zhou drank and neglected duty; rebuked by Gaozu, he turned to treason.
units.literal: Ren Zhou loved wine and neglected official business; Gaozu reproved him, and in fear Zhou plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 賴武明婁後為請，故仲禮死，不及其家。
units.en: Empress Wuming Lou pleaded for him, so only Zhongli died and his kin were spared.
units.literal: Thanks to Empress Wuming Lou’s intercession, Zhongli alone was put to death and his family was not implicated.

units.zh: 李祖升，趙國平棘人，顯祖李皇後之長兄。
units.en: Li Zusheng was from Pingji in Zhao and the elder brother of Xianzu’s Empress Li.
units.literal: Li Zusheng was a native of Pingji in Zhao Commandery and the eldest brother of Empress Li of Emperor Xianzu.

units.zh: 父希宗，上黨守。
units.en: His father Xizong had been administrator of Shangdang.
units.literal: His father Xizong was Administrator of Shangdang.

units.zh: 祖升儀容瑰麗，垂手過膝，睦姻好施，文學足以自通。
units.en: Handsome and open-handed, with hands reaching past his knees, he was gracious to kin and literate enough for polite society.
units.literal: Zusheng’s bearing was splendid; his hands hung below his knees. He was kind in kinship and generous in giving, and his literary learning sufficed for ordinary intercourse.

units.zh: 仕至齊州刺史，為徒兵所害。
units.en: He reached the post of Qi inspector before conscript soldiers killed him.
units.literal: He rose to Inspector of Qi Province and was killed by conscript soldiers.

units.zh: 弟祖勳，顯祖受禪，除秘書丞。
units.en: Younger brother Zuxun became palace librarian when Xianzu took the throne.
units.literal: His younger brother Zuxun, when Xianzu received the abdication, was appointed Secretary of the Palace Library.

units.zh: 及女為濟南王妃，除侍中，封丹陽王。
units.en: When his daughter married the Prince of Jinan, he was made palace attendant and prince of Danyang.
units.literal: When his daughter became consort to the Prince of Jinan, he was made Palace Attendant and enfeoffed Prince of Danyang.

units.zh: 濟南廢，為光州刺史。
units.en: After Jinan’s deposition he was sent to Guang as inspector.
units.literal: After Jinan was deposed, he was made Inspector of Guang Province.

units.zh: 祖勳性貪慢，兼妻崔氏驕豪干政，時論鄙之。
units.en: Greedy and arrogant, with a domineering Cui wife who meddled in affairs, he was widely scorned.
units.literal: Zuxun was greedy and arrogant, and his wife of the Cui clan was overbearing and meddled in government; contemporary opinion despised them.

units.zh: 以數坐贓免官。
units.en: Repeated corruption charges cost him his posts.
units.literal: He was repeatedly dismissed from office for corruption.

units.zh: 無才幹，自少及長，居官皆因內寵，無可稱述，卒。
units.en: Without talent he held office only through court favor; nothing in his career merits praise—he simply died.
units.literal: He had no talent; from youth to old age his offices all came through palace favor, and there is nothing worth recounting—he died.

units.zh: 元蠻，魏太師江陽王繼子，肅宗元皇後之父也。
units.en: Yuan Man was the adopted son of Wei Grand Tutor Prince Jiangyang Ji and father of Suzong’s Empress Yuan.
units.literal: Yuan Man was the adopted son of Yuan Ji, Grand Tutor and Prince of Jiangyang in Wei, and the father of Empress Yuan of Emperor Suzong.

units.zh: 歷光祿卿。
units.en: He rose to director of the imperial household.
units.literal: He served successively as Director of the Imperial Household.

units.zh: 天保十年，大誅元氏，肅宗為蠻苦請，因是追原之，賜姓步六孤氏。
units.en: In Tianbao year ten, when the Yuan were massacred, Suzong’s pleas won Man a pardon and the surname Buliugu.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Tianbao there was a great slaughter of the Yuan clan; Suzong pleaded bitterly for Man and he was therefore pardoned and granted the surname Buliugu.

units.zh: 尋病卒。
units.en: He soon died of illness.
units.literal: Shortly afterward he died of illness.

units.zh: 胡長仁，字孝隆，安定臨涇人，武成皇後之兄。
units.en: Hu Changren, styled Xiaolong, was from Linjing in Anding and elder brother of Wucheng’s Empress Hu.
units.literal: Hu Changren, courtesy name Xiaolong, was a native of Linjing in Anding and elder brother of Empress Hu of Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 父延之，魏中書令。
units.en: His father Yanzhi had been Wei’s secretariat director.
units.literal: His father Yanzhi was Secretariat Director in Wei.

units.zh: 長仁累遷右樸射及尚書令。
units.en: Changren rose to right vice director of the Masters of Writing and director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: Changren was repeatedly promoted to Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 世祖崩，預參朝政，封隴東王。
units.en: At Shizu’s death he joined in governing and was made prince of Longdong.
units.literal: When Emperor Shizu died, he took part in deliberating government and was enfeoffed Prince of Longdong.

units.zh: 左丞鄒孝裕、郎中陸仁惠、盧元亮厚相結托。
units.en: Left assistant Zou Xiaoyu and gentlemen Lu Renhui and Lu Yuanliang attached themselves to him.
units.literal: Left Assistant Zou Xiaoyu and Gentlemen of the Palace Lu Renhui and Lu Yuanliang formed a close, trusting bond with him.

units.zh: 長仁每上省，孝裕必方駕而來。
units.en: Whenever Changren entered the provincial offices, Xiaoyu arrived in a matching carriage.
units.literal: Whenever Changren went up to the provincial offices, Xiaoyu would certainly come in parallel carriages.

units.zh: 省務既繁，簿案堆積，令史欲諮都座者日有百數。
units.en: Paperwork overwhelmed the offices; a hundred clerks a day might seek the chief seat.
units.literal: Provincial business was already heavy and documents piled up; clerks wishing to consult the chief seat numbered a hundred or more each day.

units.zh: 孝裕屏人私話，朝退亦相隨，仁惠、元亮又伺間而往，停斷公事，時人號為三佞。
units.en: Xiaoyu drew him aside for private talk and followed him from court; Renhui and Yuanliang slipped in between sessions and stalled the bureaucracy—contemporaries dubbed them the Three Flatterers.
units.literal: Xiaoyu would dismiss others for private talk; after court he would follow along as well, and Renhui and Yuanliang would seize intervals to go too, halting public business—people of the time called them the Three Flatterers.

units.zh: 長仁私遊密席，處處追尋。
units.en: His secret feasts and private parties were notorious.
units.literal: Changren’s private feasts and secret gatherings were pursued and tracked everywhere.

units.zh: 孝裕勸其求進，和士開深疾之，於是奏除孝裕為章武郡守，元亮等皆出。
units.en: Xiaoyu urged him to climb higher; He Shikai, loathing this, had Xiaoyu sent to Zhangwu and the others posted away.
units.literal: Xiaoyu urged him to seek advancement; He Shikai deeply hated this, and therefore memorialized to appoint Xiaoyu as Administrator of Zhangwu Commandery and to send Yuanliang and the others out as well.

units.zh: 孝裕又說長仁曰：「王陽臥疾，士開必來，因而殺之。
units.en: Xiaoyu told Changren, “Feign illness—when Shikai comes, kill him.
units.literal: Xiaoyu again said to Changren, “If the prince feigns illness, Shikai will certainly come, and you can kill him then.

units.zh: 入見太后，不過百日失官，便代其處。」
units.en: See the empress dowager; within a hundred days you lose your post, then you take his.”
units.literal: Go in to see the empress dowager; within no more than a hundred days you will lose office, then take his place.”

units.zh: 士開知謀，徙孝裕為北營州建德郡守。
units.en: Shikai uncovered the plot and sent Xiaoyu to Jiande in North Ying Province.
units.literal: Shikai learned of the plot and transferred Xiaoyu to be Administrator of Jiande Commandery in North Ying Province.

units.zh: 後長仁倚親，驕豪無畏憚。
units.en: Later, secure in his kinship, Changren grew arrogant and fearless.
units.literal: Later Changren, relying on his kinship, was arrogant and feared nothing.

units.zh: 士開出為齊州刺史。
units.en: Shikai left the capital to be inspector of Qi Province.
units.literal: Shikai went out to serve as Inspector of Qi Province.

units.zh: 長仁怨憤，謀令剌士開，事覺，遂賜死。
units.en: Changren, bitter, plotted assassination; discovered, he was ordered to take his own life.
units.literal: Changren, resentful and angry, plotted to have Shikai assassinated; the affair was discovered and he was ordered to die.

units.zh: 尋而後主納長仁女為后，重加贈謚，長仁弟等前後七人並賜王爵，合門貴盛。
units.en: Soon the Later Lord married Changren’s daughter; honors were heaped on the dead, and seven brothers in all were made princes—the clan blazed with rank.
units.literal: Soon afterward the Later Lord took Changren’s daughter as empress and richly added posthumous honors; Changren’s younger brothers and others, seven in all before and after, were granted princely titles, and the whole household flourished in glory.

units.zh: 從祖兄長粲。
units.en: His elder clan cousin was Changcan.
units.literal: His elder clan cousin was Changcan.

units.zh: 父僧敬，即魏孝靜帝之舅，位至司空。
units.en: His father Sengjing was the maternal uncle of Emperor Xiaojing of Wei and rose to Minister of Works.
units.literal: His father Sengjing was the maternal uncle of Emperor Xiaojing of Wei and rose in office to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 長粲少而敏悟，以外戚起家給事中，遷黃門侍郎。
units.en: Changcan was quick and perceptive in youth. As an imperial in-law, he began his career as palace attendant and was transferred to gentleman attendant at the Yellow Gate.
units.literal: Changcan was quick and perceptive in youth; as an imperial in-law he began his career as palace attendant and was transferred to gentleman attendant at the Yellow Gate.

units.zh: 後主踐祚，長粲被勑與黃門馮子琮出入禁中，專典敷奏。
units.en: When the Later Sovereign ascended, Changcan was ordered, together with Yellow Gate attendant Feng Zicong, to enter and leave the palace precincts and handle the presentation of memorials.
units.literal: When the Later Sovereign ascended the throne, Changcan was ordered, together with Yellow Gate attendant Feng Zicong, to enter and leave the forbidden precincts and exclusively manage the presentation of memorials.

units.zh: 世祖崩，與領軍婁定遠、錄尚書趙彥深、和士開、高文遙、領軍綦連猛、高阿那肱、樸射唐邕同知朝政，時人號為八貴。
units.en: When Shizu died, he jointly directed court government with Lou Dingyuan, Zhao Yanshen, He Shikai, Gao Wenyao, Qilian Meng, Gao Anagong, and Vice Director Tang Yong. People of the time called them the Eight Nobles.
units.literal: When Shizu died, he, together with army commander Lou Dingyuan, recorder of the Masters of Writing Zhao Yanshen, He Shikai, Gao Wenyao, army commander Qilian Meng, Gao Anagong, and vice director Tang Yong, jointly directed court government; people of the time called them the Eight Nobles.

units.zh: 於後定遠、文遙並出，唐邕專典外兵，綦連猛、高阿那肱別總武任，長粲常在左右，兼宣詔令，從幸晉陽。
units.en: Afterward Dingyuan and Wenyao were sent out, Tang Yong managed the external troops, Qilian Meng and Gao Anagong separately oversaw military duties, and Changcan remained constantly at the sovereign's side, proclaiming edicts and following him to Jinyang.
units.literal: Afterward Dingyuan and Wenyao were both sent out, Tang Yong exclusively managed the external troops, Qilian Meng and Gao Anagong separately supervised military responsibilities, and Changcan was constantly at the sovereign's side, also proclaiming edicts and orders, and followed the imperial visit to Jinyang.

units.zh: 後主即位，富於春秋，庶事皆歸委長粲，長粲盡心毗奉，甚得名譽。
units.en: When the Later Sovereign took the throne, he was still young, so all affairs were entrusted to Changcan. Changcan devoted himself to supporting and serving him and gained a strong reputation.
units.literal: When the Later Sovereign took the throne, he was young in years, and all affairs were entrusted to Changcan; Changcan devoted his heart to supporting and serving him and gained a great reputation.

units.zh: 又為侍中。
units.en: He also became palace attendant.
units.literal: He also became palace attendant.

units.zh: 長仁心欲入處機要之地，為執政不許，長仁疑長粲通謀，大以為恨。
units.en: Changren wanted to enter the key councils, but those in power would not permit it. Suspecting that Changcan had conspired against him, Changren deeply resented him.
units.literal: Changren wished in his heart to enter a place of vital importance, but those in power did not permit it; Changren suspected that Changcan had conspired in this and deeply resented him.

units.zh: 遂言於太后，發其陰私，請出為州，後主不得已從焉。
units.en: He then spoke to the empress dowager, exposed Changcan's private misconduct, and asked that he be sent out to a province; the Later Sovereign had no choice but to agree.
units.literal: He then spoke to the empress dowager, exposed Changcan's private misconduct, and requested that he be sent out to a province; the Later Sovereign had no choice but to follow this.

units.zh: 除趙州刺史。
units.en: Changcan was appointed inspector of Zhaozhou.
units.literal: Changcan was appointed inspector of Zhaozhou.

units.zh: 及辭，長粲流涕，後主亦憫默。
units.en: When Changcan took leave, he wept, and the Later Sovereign too fell silent in pity.
units.literal: When he took leave, Changcan shed tears, and the Later Sovereign too was silent with pity.

units.zh: 至州，因沐髮手不得舉，失音，卒。
units.en: After arriving in the province, he was washing his hair when his hand would no longer lift; he lost his voice and died.
units.literal: After arriving in the province, while washing his hair his hand could not be raised; he lost his voice and died.

units.zh: 齊高祖神武皇帝，姓高名歡，字賀六渾，渤海蓚人也。
units.en: Gaozu Emperor Shenwu of Northern Qi bore the surname Gao; his personal name was Huan and his style Heiliuhun. He came from Tiao in Bohai.
units.literal: The Grand Ancestor of Qi, Emperor Shenwu, surname Gao, taboo name Huan, style name Heiliuhun, was a native of Tiao in Bohai.

units.zh: 神武上
units.en: Emperor Shenwu, Part One
units.literal: Emperor Shenwu, Part One

units.zh: 家貧，及聘武明皇后，始有馬，得給鎮為隊主。
units.en: The family was poor, and only after he betrothed Lady Wuming did he acquire a horse and win appointment as squad chief at the garrison.
units.literal: His family was poor; only when he betrothed Empress Wuming did he first have a horse and was able to serve the garrison as squad chief.

units.zh: 神武自隊主轉為函使。
units.en: Gao Huan moved from squad chief to garrison courier.
units.literal: Shenwu advanced from squad chief to courier.

units.zh: 自是乃有澄清天下之志。
units.en: From that day he resolved to set the realm right.
units.literal: From this time he nursed the ambition to cleanse and clarify the realm.

units.zh: 神武旣累世北邊，故習其俗，遂同鮮卑。
units.en: For generations his family had lived on the northern marches, so Gao Huan grew up in frontier ways and lived much like the Xianbei.
units.literal: As for generations his family had been on the northern frontier, Shenwu was accustomed to its customs and came to be as the Xianbei.

units.zh: 六世祖隱，晉玄菟太守。
units.en: In the sixth generation his ancestor Yin had been Administrator of Xuantu under the Jin.
units.literal: His sixth-generation ancestor Yin served as Administrator of Xuantu under Jin.

units.zh: 湖生四子，第三子謐，仕魏，位至侍御史，坐法徙居懷朔鎮。
units.en: Hu had four sons. The third, Mi, served the Wei court and rose to Attending Censor, but after a legal infraction was banished to live at Huaishuo garrison.
units.literal: Hu had four sons; the third, Mi, served Wei, rose to Attending Censor, and for violating the law was exiled to garrison at Huaishuo.

units.zh: 嘗乘驛過建興，雲霧晝晦，雷聲隨之，半日乃絕，若有神應者。
units.en: Once while riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day and thunder rolled after him for half a day, as though heaven itself were answering his passage.
units.literal: Once riding post through Jianxing, clouds and mist darkened the day, thunder followed along, and for half a day it did not cease — as if there were a divine response.

units.zh: 為函使六年，每至洛陽，給令史麻祥使。
units.en: For six years as courier he went each time to Luoyang, where he was assigned to the clerk Ma Xiang.
units.literal: For six years as courier, whenever he reached Luoyang he was detailed to the clerk Ma Xiang.

units.zh: 及自洛陽還，傾產以結客。
units.en: On his return from Luoyang he poured out his fortune to gather followers.
units.literal: When he returned from Luoyang, he expended his whole estate to gather clients.

units.zh: 親故怪問之，答曰：「吾至洛陽，宿衛羽林相率焚領軍張彝宅，朝廷懼其亂而不問。
units.en: Kinsmen and friends asked what moved him; he answered, "At Luoyang I saw the Feathered Forest guards burn down the residence of Supreme Commander Zhang Yi in a mob, and the court, fearing worse trouble, never punished them.
units.literal: Relatives and friends wondered and asked him; he replied: "When I reached Luoyang, the palace guards of the Feathered Forest together burned the residence of the supreme commander Zhang Yi, and the court feared their disorder and did not inquire.

units.zh: 見一赤兔，每搏輒逸，遂至回澤。
units.en: They sighted a russet hare that bolted away whenever they closed, and the chase carried them to Huize Marsh.
units.literal: They saw a red hare; each time they closed in it escaped, and they went on as far as Huize Marsh.

units.zh: 澤中有茅屋，將奔入，有狗自屋中出，噬之，鷹兔俱死。
units.en: Near a hut on the marsh the hare was nearly inside when a dog rushed out, tore at it, and killed both hawk and hare.
units.literal: In the marsh there was a thatched hut; as the hare was about to flee into it, a dog came out from the hut and bit it, and hawk and hare both died.

units.zh: 鎮將遼西段長常奇神武貌，謂曰：「君有康濟才，終不徒然。」
units.en: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, the garrison commander, often admired Gao Huan's looks and told him, "You have the talent to heal the realm; you will not end your days obscurely."
units.literal: Duan Chang of Liaoxi, commander of the garrison, often marveled at Shenwu's appearance and said to him: "You possess talent for bringing order and succor; you will not in the end come to nothing."

units.zh: 便以子孫為托。
units.en: And he entrusted his descendants to Gao Huan's care.
units.literal: He thereupon entrusted him with his descendants.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 劉貴嘗得一白鷹，與神武及尉景、蔡儁、子如、賈顯智等獵於沃野。
units.en: Liu Gui once came by a white hawk and went hunting on the open steppe with Gao Huan, Wei Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and the rest.
units.literal: Liu Gui once obtained a white hawk and hunted on the open fields with Shenwu, Jing, Cai Jun, Ziru, Jia Xianzhi, and others.

units.zh: 及神武生而皇妣韓氏殂，養於同產姊婿鎮獄隊尉景家。
units.en: When Gao Huan was born his mother Lady Han died, and he was reared in the household of his full elder sister's husband Wei Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.
units.literal: When Shenwu was born the late mother Lady Han died, and he was raised in the home of his uterine elder sister's husband, Jing, captain of the garrison prison guard.

units.zh: 長而深沉有大度，輕財重士，為豪俠所宗。
units.en: As a man he was reserved and far-sighted, generous with money and devoted to worthy companions, and the local men of daring looked to him as their leader.
units.literal: When grown he was deep and reserved, possessed of great breadth of mind, lightly regarded wealth and valued men of talent, and was looked to by bold heroes.

units.zh: 目有精光，長頭高顴，齒白如玉，少有人傑表。
units.en: His eyes gleamed, his head was long and his cheekbones high, his teeth white as jade; even in youth he wore the bearing of a man marked for greatness.
units.literal: His eyes had a sharp brilliance; his head was long and cheeks high; his teeth white as jade — in youth he had the countenance of an uncommon man.

units.zh: 詳嘗以肉啖神武，神武性不立食，坐而進之。
units.en: Xiang once fed him meat; Gao Huan, who never ate standing, sat down to accept it.
units.literal: Xiang once offered meat to Shenwu to eat; Shenwu by nature would not eat standing, and so sat to receive it.

units.zh: 因自言善暗相，遍捫諸人皆貴，而指麾俱由神武。
units.en: Declaring herself skilled in reading fate by touch, she passed her hands over each man and pronounced them all destined for rank, yet said every fortune turned on Gao Huan.
units.literal: She then said herself that she was skilled at reading fortune by touch; she felt over everyone and found them all noble, yet all destinies depended on Shenwu's direction.

units.zh: 由是諸人益加敬異。
units.en: From that day his companions held him in still greater awe.
units.literal: From this the company all the more revered and marvelled at him.

units.zh: 為政若此，事可知也。
units.en: When government runs thus, the course of events is already clear.
units.literal: When government is like this, how affairs will turn out is plain to see.

units.zh: 財物豈可常守邪？」
units.en: What good is clinging to property forever?"
units.literal: Can wealth and goods be kept forever?"

units.zh: 又嘗夢履衆星而行，覺而內喜。
units.en: He also dreamed once that he walked treading upon the stars; when he woke he was secretly elated.
units.literal: Again he once dreamed of treading among the stars as he walked; waking, he rejoiced inwardly.

units.zh: 祥以為慢己，笞神武四十。
units.en: Xiang took this as an insult and had Gao Huan beaten forty strokes.
units.literal: Xiang took this as disrespect toward himself and had Shenwu flogged forty strokes.

units.zh: 神武怒，以鳴鏑射之，狗斃。
units.en: Gao Huan, furious, killed the dog with a whistling arrow.
units.literal: Shenwu in anger shot it with a whistling arrow and killed the dog.

units.zh: 飯竟出，行數里還，更訪之，則本無人居，乃向非人也。
units.en: After the meal they rode on, but a few li later turned back to find the place, and there was no hut at all—their hosts had not been of this world.
units.literal: When the meal was done they left; after going several li they turned back to visit again, but where there had been no dwelling at all — those before had not been human.

units.zh: 每行道路，往來無風塵之色。
units.en: Whenever he traveled the roads he seemed untouched by wind and dust.
units.literal: Whenever he traveled the roads, there was no look of wind and dust about his coming and going.

units.zh: 及貴，追贈長司空，擢其子寧用之。
units.en: After Gao Huan rose to power he posthumously honored Duan Chang with the title Minister of Works and brought his son Ning into office.
units.literal: When Shenwu rose high, he posthumously enfeoffed Chang as Minister of Works and promoted his son Ning to employment.

units.zh: 屋中有二人出，持神武襟甚急。
units.en: Two men burst from the hut and seized Gao Huan's robe in alarm.
units.literal: Two men came out from the hut and seized Shenwu's robe with great urgency.

units.zh: 以太子少傅魏收為兼尚書右僕射。
units.en: Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was made Concurrent Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince Wei Shou was appointed Concurrent Right Deputy Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 己卯，兼右僕射魏收以阿縱除名。
units.en: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.
units.literal: On the jimao day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Wei Shou was dismissed from office for fawning and indulgence.

units.zh: 遂奔葛榮，又亡歸尒朱榮於秀容。
units.en: He fled next to Ge Rong, then broke away again and took refuge with Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.
units.literal: He then fled to Ge Rong, and again broke away and returned to Erzhu Rong at Xiurong.

units.zh: 先是，劉貴事榮，盛言神武美，至是始得見，以憔悴故，未之奇也。
units.en: Liu Gui had long served Erzhu Rong and spoken lavishly of Gao Huan's gifts; now Gao Huan finally met Rong face to face, but worn and haggard as he was, Rong saw nothing remarkable in him.
units.literal: Earlier Liu Gui had served Rong and lavishly praised Shenwu's excellence; only now did he first gain an audience, but because he was haggard, Rong did not regard him as extraordinary.

units.zh: 旣而榮以神武為親信都督。
units.en: Soon after, Erzhu Rong appointed Gao Huan trusted commander.
units.literal: Shortly thereafter Rong made Shenwu trusted commander.

units.zh: 于於時魏明帝銜鄭儼、徐紇，逼靈太后，未敢制，私使榮舉兵內向。
units.en: At that time Emperor Ming of Northern Wei loathed Zheng Yan and Xu He, who dominated Empress Dowager Ling, but dared not move against them openly; he secretly urged Erzhu Rong to march on the capital.
units.literal: At this time Wei Emperor Ming bore hatred for Zheng Yan and Xu He, who pressed the Empress Dowager Ling; he dared not restrain them and secretly sent Rong to raise troops inward.

units.zh: 及尒朱榮擊葛榮，令神武喻下賊別稱王者七人。
units.en: When Erzhu Rong campaigned against Ge Rong, he sent Gao Huan to talk seven rebel kings into surrender.
units.literal: When Erzhu Rong attacked Ge Rong, he had Shenwu persuade seven bandit chiefs styling themselves kings to submit.

units.zh: 累遷第三鎮人酋長，常在榮帳內。
units.en: He rose to become chief of the third garrison peoples and remained constantly at Erzhu Rong's side.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to chief of the third garrison populations and was constantly within Rong's tent.

units.zh: 於是大聚斂，因劉貴貨榮下要人，盡得其意。
units.en: Gao Huan amassed wealth on a grand scale and, through Liu Gui, bought off Erzhu Rong's inner circle until he knew their minds completely.
units.literal: Thereupon he greatly gathered riches; through Liu Gui he bribed Rong's key men and came fully to know their intentions.

units.zh: 時州庫角無故自鳴，神武異之，無幾而孝莊誅榮。
units.en: About then a horn in the provincial storehouse sounded of its own accord; Gao Huan took it for an omen—and soon Emperor Xiaozhuang killed Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: At the time the horn of the provincial storehouse spontaneously sounded without cause; Shenwu took it as strange; before long Xiaozhuang executed Rong.

units.zh: 因隨榮之廄。
units.en: He then followed Rong into the stables.
units.literal: Thereupon he followed Rong to the stables.

units.zh: 廄有惡馬，榮命翦之。
units.en: A vicious stallion was in the stable, and Rong ordered its mane clipped.
units.literal: In the stable there was a vicious horse; Rong ordered its mane clipped.

units.zh: 榮遂坐神武於床下，屏左右而訪時事。
units.en: Rong then seated Gao Huan below his couch, dismissed his attendants, and questioned him on the state of the realm.
units.literal: Rong thereupon seated Shenwu below his couch, dismissed those on either side, and inquired about current affairs.

units.zh: 榮曰：「但言爾意。」
units.en: Rong replied, "Tell me what you have in mind."
units.literal: Rong said: "Just speak your mind."

units.zh: 榮大悅，語自日中至夜半，乃出。
units.en: Rong was delighted; they talked from noon until midnight before Gao Huan left.
units.literal: Rong was greatly pleased; they spoke from midday until midnight before he departed.

units.zh: 後從榮徙據幷州，抵揚州邑人龐蒼鷹，止團焦中。
units.en: Later, when Rong shifted his base to Bing Province, Gao Huan stayed with Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township in a round-walled compound called Tuanjiao.
units.literal: Later following Rong he moved to hold Bing Province, arrived at Pang Cangying of Yangzhou township, and lodged in a round walled compound.

units.zh: 榮以神武為前鋒。
units.en: Rong made Gao Huan his vanguard.
units.literal: Rong made Shenwu vanguard.

units.zh: 及帝暴崩，榮遂入洛，因將篡位。
units.en: When the emperor died suddenly, Rong entered Luoyang and prepared to seize the throne himself.
units.literal: When the emperor suddenly died, Rong then entered Luoyang and intended to usurp the throne.

units.zh: 榮嘗問左右曰：「一日無我，誰可主軍？」
units.en: Rong once asked his companions, "If I were gone, who could lead these armies?"
units.literal: Rong once asked those beside him: "One day without me — who could command the army?"

units.zh: 以明公雄武，乘時奮發，討鄭儼、徐紇而清帝側，霸業可舉鞭而成。
units.en: With your might, my lord, rise now, strike down Zheng Yan and Xu He, cleanse the emperor's side—and dominion over the realm is yours at a flick of the whip.
units.literal: With your heroic martial power, sir, if you seize the moment and strike, punish Zheng Yan and Xu He and cleanse the emperor's side — hegemony can be achieved at a flick of the whip.

units.zh: 皆稱尒朱兆。
units.en: All named Erzhu Zhao.
units.literal: All named Erzhu Zhao.

units.zh: 因誡兆曰：「爾非其匹，終當為其穿鼻。」
units.en: He warned Zhao, "You are no match for him; in the end he will put the ring in your nose."
units.literal: He thereupon warned Zhao: "You are not his match; in the end you will be bridled by him."

units.zh: 至上黨，明帝又私詔停之。
units.en: When the army reached Shangdang, the emperor secretly ordered a halt.
units.literal: Reaching Shangdang, Ming again privately ordered him to halt.

units.zh: 曰：「此正可統三千騎以還，堪代我主衆者，唯賀六渾耳。」
units.en: Rong said, "Zhao can lead three thousand horsemen home, but only Heiliuhun is fit to replace me in command of the host."
units.literal: He said: "This one can just lead three thousand cavalry back; the man fit to replace me in commanding the masses is only Heiliuhun."

units.zh: 神武諫，恐不聽，請鑄像卜之，鑄不成，乃止。
units.en: Gao Huan remonstrated; fearing Rong would not heed him, he had a Buddha image cast for divination—and when the casting failed, Rong abandoned the plan.
units.literal: Shenwu remonstrated; fearing he would not listen, he asked to cast an image and divined by it; the casting did not succeed, and so Rong stopped.

units.zh: 周朝優詔答曰：「昔主父從戮，孔車有長者之風，彭越就誅，欒布得陪臣之禮。
units.en: Zhou replied graciously: "When Zhufu Yan was executed, Kong Che showed an elder's bearing; when Peng Yue was put to death, Luan Bu received a subject's rites.
units.literal: The Zhou court replied with a gracious edict, saying: "In old times when Zhufu Yan followed execution, Kong Che had an elder's bearing; when Peng Yue met execution, Luan Bu received a subject's rites.

units.zh: 丙戌，立妃胡氏為皇后，子緯為皇太子。
units.en: On bingxu, Consort Hu was made empress and his son Wei was made crown prince.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, he established Consort Hu as empress and his son Wei as crown prince.

units.zh: 和士開請止樂，帝大怒，撻之。
units.en: He Shikai asked that the music be stopped; the emperor was greatly angered and beat him.
units.literal: He Shikai asked that the music be stopped; the emperor was greatly angered and beat him.

units.zh: 武成崩，尊為皇太后，陸媼及和士開密謀殺趙郡王叡，出婁定遠、高文遙為刺史。
units.en: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.
units.literal: When Wucheng died she was honored as Empress Dowager; Nurse Lu and He Shikai secretly plotted to kill Prince Rui of Zhao Commandery and sent out Lou Dingyuan and Gao Wenyao as governors.

units.zh: 武成寵倖和士開，每與后握槊，因此與后姦通。
units.en: Wucheng favored He Shikai; he often played polo with the empress, and through this came to commit adultery with her.
units.literal: Wucheng favored He Shikai; he often played polo with the empress, and through this came to commit adultery with her.

units.zh: 和、陸諂事太后，無所不至。
units.en: He and Lu fawned upon the empress dowager to every extreme.
units.literal: He and Lu fawned upon the empress dowager to every extreme.

units.zh: 世宗文襄皇帝，諱澄，字子惠，神武長子也，母曰婁太后。
units.en: Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong of Northern Qi, bore the personal name Cheng and the style Zihui. He was the eldest son of Gao Huan; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong Wenxiang, taboo name Cheng, style Zihui, was the eldest son of Shenwu; his mother was Empress Dowager Lou.

units.zh: 王嘗侍飲，舉大觴曰：「臣澄勸陛下酒。」
units.en: Once, while attending him at drink, Gao Cheng raised a great goblet and said, "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."
units.literal: Once, while attending him at drink, the Prince raised a great goblet and said: "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty to drink."

units.zh: 齊受禪，追諡為文襄皇帝，廟號世宗。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, with the temple name Shizong.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was posthumously titled Emperor Wenxiang, temple name Shizong.

units.zh: 七月戊戌，魏帝詔以文襄為使持節、大丞相、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事、大行臺、渤海王。
units.en: In the seventh month, on wuxu day, the Eastern Wei emperor issued an edict that Gao Cheng be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on wuxu, the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Wenxiang be Bearer of Credentials, Grand Chancellor, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies at Home and Abroad, Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 魏中興元年，立為渤海王世子。
units.en: In Zhongxing 1 (531) he was made heir to the Prince of Bohai.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing of Wei he was established as heir of the Prince of Bohai.

units.zh: 三年，入輔朝政，加領左右、京畿大都督。
units.en: In the third year he entered the capital to assist in governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and made Grand Commander of the Capital Region.
units.literal: In the third year he entered to assist court governance and was given charge of the Left and Right and Grand Commander of the Capital Region.

units.zh: 興和二年，加大將軍，領中書監，仍攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Xinghe 2 (540) he was made Grand General and Director of the Secretariat Supervisor while still serving as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the second year of Xinghe he was given Grand General, Director of the Secretariat Supervisor, and still acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 魏帝詔曰：「旣朝野攸憑，安危所系，不得令遂本懷，須有權奪，可復前大將軍，餘如故。」
units.en: The emperor issued an edict, "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your wish; authority must be taken by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."
units.literal: The Wei Emperor issued an edict: "Since court and countryside rely on you and safety hangs upon you, I cannot let you follow your original wish; there must be a taking of authority by necessity. You may resume your former rank of Grand General; the rest remains as before."

units.zh: 元象元年，攝吏部尚書。
units.en: In Yuanxiang 1 (538) he served as acting Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang he acted as Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 選人常以年勞為制，文襄乃釐改前式，銓擢唯在得人。
units.en: appointments had been governed by seniority; Gao Cheng reformed the old practice so that selection rested only on finding the right men.
units.literal: appointments had been governed by years of service; Wenxiang then reformed the former practice, and selection and promotion rested only on getting the right men.

units.zh: 二年，加侍中、開府儀同三司，尚孝靜帝妹馮翊長公主，時年十二，神情儁爽，便若成人。
units.en: In the second year he was made Palace Attendant and Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator and married Princess Chang of Fengyi, Emperor Xiaojing's sister. He was twelve, handsome and spirited, already bearing himself like a man.
units.literal: In the second year he was given Palace Attendant, Grand Lord Equal to Three Imperator, and married the Princess Chang of Fengyi, sister of Emperor Xiaojing; he was then twelve, with a handsome and spirited bearing, already like a grown man.

units.zh: 壬寅，魏帝詔太原公洋攝理軍國，遣中使敦喻。
units.en: On renyin day the emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang administer military and state affairs and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.
units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時王居北城東柏堂蒞政，以寵琅邪公主，欲其來往無所避忌，所有侍衛，皆出於外。
units.en: At the time Gao Cheng held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.
units.literal: At the time the Prince held court at the East Cypress Hall in the North City; favoring the Princess of Langye, he wished her comings and goings to be without restraint, and had all guards posted outside.

units.zh: 就杜詢講學，敏悟過人，詢甚嘆服。
units.en: He studied under Du Xun; his quickness of mind surpassed all others, and Du Xun came to admire him deeply.
units.literal: He went to Du Xun to study; his quick comprehension surpassed others, and Xun greatly admired him.

units.zh: 天平元年，加使持節、尚書令、大行臺、幷州刺史。
units.en: In Tianping 1 (534) he received Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and the inspectorship of Bing Province.
units.literal: In the first year of Tianping he was given Bearer of Credentials, Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Mobile Headquarters, and Inspector of Bing Province.

units.zh: 辛卯，王遇盜而殂，時年二十九。
units.en: On xinmao Gao Cheng fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.
units.literal: On xinmao the Prince fell to assassins and died; he was twenty-nine.

units.zh: 賊黨去床，因而見殺。
units.en: The assassins dragged him from the bed and killed him.
units.literal: The assassins dragged him from the bed and so he was killed.

units.zh: 葬于峻成陵。
units.en: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.
units.literal: He was buried at Juncheng Tomb.

units.zh: 王以為信然，謂可誘而致，乃遺景書曰：
units.en: Gao Cheng believed it and thought he could be lured back; he sent Hou Jing a letter saying,
units.literal: The Prince believed it true and thought he could be lured back; he sent Jing a letter saying:

units.zh: 先王與司徒契闊夷險，孤子相依，偏所眷屬，義貫終始，情存歲寒。
units.en: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you—you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.
units.literal: The late king and the Minister of Works shared hardship through peril and isolation; I, his orphan, depended on you — you were his special charge. Righteousness ran from first to last; affection endured through the cold years.

units.zh: 待為國士者乃立漆身之節，饋以一餐者便致扶輪之效，況其重於此乎？
units.en: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel—how much more when the bond was weightier than this?
units.literal: Those treated as men of the state would lay down their lives; one who was fed a single meal would repay with the deed of bracing the wheel — how much more when the bond was weightier than this?

units.zh: 常以故舊之義，欲將子孫相托，方為秦晉之匹，共成劉、范之親。
units.en: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.
units.literal: By the old friendship I ever meant to entrust my descendants to you and make a match like Qin and Jin, forming a kinship like Liu and Fan.

units.zh: 況聞負杖行歌，便以狼顧反噬，不蹈忠臣之路，便陷叛人之地。
units.en: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.
units.literal: Yet I hear that leaning on your staff and singing in the lanes, you turned like a wolf to bite in return, forsook the path of the loyal minister, and fell into the land of the rebel.

units.zh: 力不足以自強，勢不足以自保，率烏合之衆，為累卵之危。
units.en: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.
units.literal: Your strength is not enough to strengthen yourself; your power is not enough to protect yourself; you lead a rabble host and stand in peril like a pile of eggs.

units.zh: 西取救於宇文，南請援於蕭氏，以狐疑之心，為首鼠之事。
units.en: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house—with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.
units.literal: West you seek rescue from Yuwen; south you ask aid from the Xiao house — with a doubting heart you do the deed of a wavering rat.

units.zh: 入秦則秦人不容，歸吳則吳人不信。
units.en: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.
units.literal: Enter Qin and the men of Qin will not receive you; return to Wu and the men of Wu will not trust you.

units.zh: 當是不逞之人，曲為無端之說，遂懷市虎之疑，乃致投杼之惑。
units.en: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.
units.literal: Surely it was men of disorder who twisted groundless words, so that you harbored the suspicion of the tiger in the market and fell into the confusion of the thrown shuttle.

units.zh: 比來舉止，事已可見，人相疑誤，想自覺知。
units.en: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.
units.literal: Your conduct of late is already plain to see; men suspect and err, and I think you know it yourself.

units.zh: 闔門大小，悉在司寇，意謂李氏未滅，猶言少卿可反。
units.en: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.
units.literal: Your whole household, great and small, is in the hands of the Minister of Justice; I thought that since the Li clan was not yet destroyed, one might still say the Lesser Minister could return.

units.zh: 孤子無狀招禍，丁天酷罰，但禮由權奪，志在忘私，聊遣偏裨，前驅致討，南兗、揚州，應時剋復。
units.en: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment—yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.
units.literal: I, the orphan, unworthy, have drawn calamity; heaven has dealt a cruel punishment — yet ritual allows taking authority by necessity, and my aim is to forget private feeling. I have sent only a partial force as vanguard to attack; southern Yanzhou and Yangzhou were recovered at once.

units.zh: 即欲乘機，席捲縣瓠，屬以炎暑，欲為後圖，且令還師，待時更舉。
units.en: I meant to seize the moment and sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.
units.literal: I meant to seize the moment, sweep up Xiangcheng, but because of the heat I planned for later and for now ordered withdrawal, to strike again when the time comes.

units.zh: 今寒膠向折，白露將團，方憑國靈，龔行天罰。
units.en: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.
units.literal: Now the cold glue is about to break and white dew will soon gather; relying on the state's numen, I march to execute heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 器械精新，士馬強盛，內外感恩，上下戮力，三令五申，可赴湯火。
units.en: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.
units.literal: Weapons are sharp and new, soldiers and horses strong; within and without men are grateful, above and below strive together; thrice and five times commanded, they would walk into boiling water.

units.zh: 使旗鼓相望，埃塵相接，勢如沃雪，事等注熒。
units.en: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.
units.literal: Banners and drums face each other, dust and smoke meet; the force is like pouring water on snow, the affair like pouring oil on flame.

units.zh: 夫明者去危就安，智者轉禍為福，甯人負我，不我負人，當開從善之途，使有改迷之路。
units.en: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others—open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.
units.literal: The clear-sighted leave peril for safety; the wise turn calamity into blessing. Better that others wrong me than that I wrong others — open the path of accepting good, and give a road for correcting error.

units.zh: 若能卷甲來朝，垂橐還闕者，即當授豫州，必使終君身世。
units.en: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.
units.literal: If you can roll up your armor and come to court, empty your bags and return to the capital, I will at once grant you Yuzhou and see that you hold it for life.

units.zh: 所部文武更不追攝，進得保其祿位，退則不喪功名。
units.en: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.
units.literal: Your civil and military subordinates will not be pursued; advance and you keep rank and salary, retreat and you lose neither merit nor fame.

units.zh: 今王思政等皆孤軍偏將，遠來深入，然其性命在君掌握，脫能刺之，想有餘力。
units.en: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand—if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.
units.literal: Now Wang Sizheng and the rest are isolated generals who came from afar and marched deep; yet their lives are in your hand — if you can stab them, I think you still have strength enough.

units.zh: 節相加授，永保疆埸。
units.en: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.
units.literal: I will add the seal of minister and forever secure the frontier.

units.zh: 君門眷屬，可以無患，寵妻愛子，亦送相還，仍為通家，共成親好。
units.en: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back—we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.
units.literal: Your household kin need not fear; your cherished wife and beloved sons I will also send back — we shall again be allied houses and form a close bond.

units.zh: 君今不能東封函谷，南面稱孤，受制於人，威名頓盡。
units.en: If you cannot now seal Hangu Pass in the east and call yourself king facing south, but must be controlled by others, your renown will at once be spent.
units.literal: If you cannot now seal Hangu Pass in the east and call yourself king facing south, but must be controlled by others, your renown will at once be spent.

units.zh: 得地不欲自守，聚衆不以為強，空使身有背叛之名，家有惡逆之禍，覆宗絕嗣，自貽伊戚。
units.en: You gain land yet will not hold it yourself; you gather a host yet do not count it strong—in vain you bear the name of rebel and your house the calamity of treason; clan extinguished, line cut off, you bring sorrow on yourself.
units.literal: You gain land yet will not hold it yourself; you gather a host yet do not count it strong — in vain you bear the name of rebel and your house the calamity of treason; clan extinguished, line cut off, you bring sorrow on yourself.

units.zh: 戴天履地，能無愧乎！
units.en: Wearing heaven on your head and treading earth underfoot—can you be without shame!
units.literal: Wearing heaven on your head and treading earth underfoot — can you be without shame!

units.zh: 孤子今日不應遣此，但見蔡遵道云：「司徒本無西歸之心，深有悔過之意」，未知此語為虛為實。
units.en: I, the orphan, ought not to send this today, but I saw Cai Zundao say, "The Minister of Works originally had no mind to go west and deeply wished to repent"—I do not know whether these words are empty or real.
units.literal: I, the orphan, ought not to send this today, but I saw Cai Zundao say: "The Minister of Works originally had no mind to go west and deeply wished to repent" — I do not know whether these words are empty or real.

units.zh: 吉凶之理，想自圖之。
units.en: The logic of fortune and calamity—I think you will weigh it yourself.
units.literal: The logic of fortune and calamity — I think you will weigh it yourself.

units.zh: 論曰：文襄嗣膺霸道，威略昭著。
units.en: The appraisal says: Wenxiang inherited the hegemonic enterprise, and his power and strategy were unmistakable.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Wenxiang succeeded to the hegemonic enterprise, and his martial strategy was plainly displayed.

units.zh: 而志在峻法，急於禦下，於前王之德，有所未同。
units.en: Yet he set his mind on harsh law and was impatient in ruling those below him; in this he fell short of the former king's virtue.
units.literal: Yet his intent lay in severe laws and he was harsh in governing subordinates; in the virtue of the former king, there was something with which he did not accord.

units.zh: 生而岐嶷，神武異之。
units.en: From birth he was precocious and keen; Gao Huan took him for a prodigy.
units.literal: From birth he was precocious and sharp; Shenwu regarded him as extraordinary.

units.zh: 武定四年十一月，神武西討，不豫班師，文襄馳赴軍所，侍衛還晉陽。
units.en: In the eleventh month of Wuding 4 (546), Gao Huan marched west, fell ill, and withdrew; Gao Cheng raced to the army, attended him, and escorted him back to Jinyang.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year of Wuding, Shenwu campaigned west and, falling ill, withdrew the army; Wenxiang raced to the army's camp, attended him, and escorted him back to Jinyang.

units.zh: 五年正月丙午，神武崩，秘不發喪。
units.en: In the first month of Wuding 5 (547), on bingwu day, Gao Huan died; the death was kept secret.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, on bingwu, Shenwu died; the death was kept secret.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申，文襄朝於鄴。
units.en: In the fourth month, on renshen day, Gao Cheng attended court at Ye.
units.literal: In the fourth month, on renshen, Wenxiang attended court at Ye.

units.zh: 秘不發喪，徐出言曰：「奴反，大將軍被傷，無大苦也。」
units.en: They kept the death secret, then slowly announced, "The slave rebelled; the Grand General was wounded—nothing grave."
units.literal: They kept the death secret, then slowly announced: "The slave rebelled; the Grand General was wounded—nothing grave."

units.zh: 文襄乃奏吏部郎崔暹為御史中尉，糾劾權豪，無所縱捨，於是風俗更始，私枉路絕。
units.en: Gao Cheng then had Cui Xian of the Ministry of Personnel appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful without sparing any, custom was renewed, and private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.
units.literal: Wenxiang then memorialized to make Cui Xuan of the Ministry of Personnel Vice Censor-in-Chief; he impeached the powerful and wealthy without sparing any, and custom was renewed — private wrongdoing and bribery ceased.

units.zh: 遣司空韓軌率衆討之。
units.en: Gao Cheng sent Minister of Works Han Gui at the head of an army to attack him.
units.literal: He sent Minister of Works Han Gui at the head of an army to attack him.

units.zh: 丁丑，文襄還晉陽，乃發喪，告喻文武，陳神武遺志。
units.en: On dingchou day Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang, announced the death, informed civil and military officials, and set forth Gao Huan's final wishes.
units.literal: On dingchou Wenxiang returned to Jinyang, then announced the death, informed civil and military officials, and set forth Shenwu's final wishes.

units.zh: 文襄啟辭位，願停王爵。
units.en: Gao Cheng memorialized to decline and wished to relinquish the princely rank.
units.literal: Wenxiang memorialized to decline the post and wished to relinquish the princely rank.

units.zh: 八月戊辰，文襄啟申神武遺令，請減國邑分封將督，各有差。
units.en: In the eighth month, on wuchen day, Gao Cheng memorialized to carry out Gao Huan's final command, asking to reduce the royal fief and enfeoff generals and commanders, each according to rank.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuchen, Wenxiang memorialized to carry out Shenwu's final command, asking to reduce the fiefs of the realm and enfeoff generals and commanders, each according to rank.

units.zh: 王尋覽書，問誰為作。
units.en: When Gao Cheng had read the letter, he asked who had written it.
units.literal: When the Prince had read the letter, he asked who had written it.

units.zh: 王曰：「偉才如此，何因不使我知？」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "With talent like this, why was I not told?"
units.literal: The Prince said: "With talent like this, why was I not told?"

units.zh: 王欲間景於梁，又與景書而謬其辭，云本使景陽叛，欲與圖西，西人知之，故景更與圖南為事。
units.en: Gao Cheng wished to drive a wedge between Hou Jing and Liang, and wrote to Jing with falsified wording, saying he had originally sent Jing to stir rebellion at Jingyang and meant to plot the west together; when Western Wei learned of it, Jing turned instead to plotting with the south.
units.literal: The Prince wished to drive a wedge between Jing and Liang, and wrote to Jing with falsified wording, saying he had originally had Jing stir rebellion at Jingyang and planned with him to strike west; when Western Wei learned this, Jing turned instead to scheming with the south.

units.zh: 壬申，東魏主與王獵於鄴東，馳逐如飛。
units.en: On renshen the Eastern Wei emperor hunted with Gao Cheng east of Ye, galloping as if in flight.
units.literal: On renshen, the Eastern Wei emperor hunted with the Prince east of Ye, racing as if flying.

units.zh: 監衛都督烏那羅受工伐從後呼曰：「天子莫走馬，大將軍怒。」
units.en: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougongfa shouted from behind, "Your Majesty, do not gallop—the Grand General will be angry!"
units.literal: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougongfa shouted from behind: "Your Majesty, do not gallop—the Grand General will be angry!"

units.zh: 王怒曰：「朕！
units.en: Gao Cheng raged, "Imperial We!
units.literal: The Prince raged: "Imperial We!

units.zh: 東魏主賜季舒彩，季舒未敢即受，啟之於王，王使取一段。
units.en: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to Gao Cheng, who told him to take one bolt.
units.literal: The Eastern Wei emperor bestowed silk on Jishu; Jishu dared not accept at once and reported to the Prince, who told him to take one bolt.

units.zh: 三月辛亥，王南臨黎陽，濟於虎牢，自洛陽從太行而反晉陽。
units.en: On xinhai of the third month Gao Cheng went south to Liyang, crossed at Hulao, and returned to Jinyang from Luoyang by way of the Taihang.
units.literal: On xinhai of the third month, the Prince went south to Liyang, crossed at Hulao, and returned to Jinyang by way of Taihang from Luoyang.

units.zh: 六月，王巡北邊城戍，賑賜有差。
units.en: In the sixth month Gao Cheng toured the northern border forts and gave relief in varying measure.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Prince toured northern border forts and gave relief in varying measure.

units.zh: 七月，王還晉陽。
units.en: In the seventh month Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Prince returned to Jinyang.

units.zh: 識者以為王將殂之兆也。
units.en: Those who understood took it as an omen that Gao Cheng would die.
units.literal: Those who understood took it as an omen that the Prince would die.

units.zh: 初，梁將蘭欽子京為東魏所虜，王命以配廚。
units.en: Earlier, Zi Jing, son of the Liang general Lan Qin, had been captured by Eastern Wei; Gao Cheng ordered him assigned to the kitchen staff.
units.literal: Earlier, Zi Jing, son of Liang General Lan Qin, had been captured by Eastern Wei; the Prince ordered him assigned to the kitchen staff.

units.zh: 欽請贖之，王不許。
units.en: Lan Qin asked to ransom him; Gao Cheng refused.
units.literal: Lan Qin asked to ransom him; the Prince refused.

units.zh: 京再訴，王使監廚蒼頭薛豐洛杖之，曰：「更訴當殺爾。」
units.en: Jing appealed again; Gao Cheng had the kitchen-overseer bondman Xue Fengluo beat him and said, "Complain again and you will be killed."
units.literal: Jing appealed again; the Prince had kitchen-overseer bondman Xue Fengluo beat him and said: "Complain again and you will be killed."

units.zh: 王曰：「小人新杖之，故嚇我耳。」
units.en: Gao Cheng said, "That wretch was just flogged—he only wants to frighten me."
units.literal: The Prince said: "That wretch was just flogged—he only wants to frighten me."

units.zh: 京將進食，王却，謂諸人曰：「昨夜夢此奴斫我，宜殺却。」
units.en: When Jing was about to bring food, Gao Cheng held back and told the others, "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked at me—I ought to kill him."
units.literal: When Jing was about to bring food, the Prince held back and told the others: "Last night I dreamed this slave hacked at me—I ought to kill him."

units.zh: 王怒曰：「我未索食，爾何據來！」
units.en: Gao Cheng raged, "I did not ask for food—why do you press in!"
units.literal: The Prince raged: "I did not ask for food—why do you press in!"

units.zh: 王自投傷足，入于床下。
units.en: Gao Cheng threw himself aside, wounded in the foot, and crawled under the bed.
units.literal: The Prince threw himself aside, wounded in the foot, and crawled under the bed.

units.zh: 然文襄之禍生所忽，蓋有由焉。
units.en: Yet Wenxiang's disaster grew out of what he neglected; it had its cause.
units.literal: Yet Wenxiang's disaster arose from what he neglected; there was surely a cause for it.

units.zh: 與呼延族、莫多婁敬顯、尉相願同謀，期正月五日，孝珩於千秋門斬高阿那肱，相願在內以禁兵應之，族與敬顯自遊豫園勒兵出。
units.en: He joined with Huyan Zu, Moduolou Jingxian, and Wei Xiangyuan in a common plot, fixing the fifth day of the first month: Xiaoheng was to behead Gao Anaogong at the Gate of a Thousand Autumns; Xiangyuan inside would respond with the forbidden guard; Zu and Jingxian would lead troops out from the Pleasure Garden.
units.literal: He joined with Huyan Zu, Moduolou Jingxian, and Wei Xiangyuan in a common plot, fixing the fifth day of the first month: Xiaoheng was to behead Gao Anaogong at the Gate of a Thousand Autumns; Xiangyuan inside would respond with the forbidden guard; Zu and Jingxian would lead troops out from the Pleasure Garden.

units.zh: 高、韓恐其變，出孝珩為滄州刺史。
units.en: Gao and Han, fearing he might change, sent Xiaoheng out as Governor of Cang Province.
units.literal: Gao and Han, fearing he might change, sent Xiaoheng out as Governor of Cang Province.

units.zh: 既而阿那肱從別宅取便路入宮，事不果。
units.en: Before long Anaogong took a shortcut from another residence into the palace, and the affair did not succeed.
units.literal: Before long Anaogong took a shortcut from another residence into the palace, and the affair did not succeed.

units.zh: 乃求出拒西軍，謂阿那肱、韓長鸞、陳德信等云：「朝廷不賜遣擊賊，豈不畏孝珩反耶？
units.en: He then asked to go out to resist the western army, saying to Anaogong, Han Changluan, Chen Dexin, and the others, "The court will not grant permission to go out and strike the enemy — are you not afraid Xiaoheng will rebel?
units.literal: He then asked to go out to resist the western army, saying to Anaogong, Han Changluan, Chen Dexin, and the others, "The court will not grant permission to go out and strike the enemy — are you not afraid Xiaoheng will rebel?

units.zh: 怒曰：「由高阿那肱小人，吾道窮矣！」
units.en: In anger he said, "Because of the petty man Gao Anaogong, my road is at an end!"
units.literal: In anger he said, "Because of the petty man Gao Anaogong, my road is at an end!"

units.zh: 時太原公洋在城東雙堂，入而討賊，臠割京等，皆漆其頭。
units.en: At the time Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.
units.literal: At the time Prince of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.

units.zh: 丙戌，以兼尚書右僕射趙彥深為左僕射。
units.en: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Vice Director Zhao Yanshen was made Left Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: On the bingxu day, Concurrent Right Deputy Director Zhao Yanshen was appointed Left Deputy Director.

units.zh: 及為右僕射，又說後主禁屠宰，斷酤酒。
units.en: When he was right vice minister, he again persuaded the Last Emperor to forbid slaughter and cut off the sale of wine.
units.literal: When he was Right Vice Minister, he again persuaded the Last Emperor to forbid slaughter and cut off the sale of wine.

units.zh: 後主時，斫骨光弁奉使至州，思好迎之甚謹，光弁倨敖，思好因心銜恨。
units.en: Under the Later Lord, Zhuogu Guangbian came to the province on mission. Sihao received him with scrupulous courtesy; Guangbian repaid him with arrogance — and Sihao nursed the insult in silence.
units.literal: In the time of the Later Lord, Zhuogu Guangbian came on mission to the province; Sihao received him with great courtesy, but Guangbian was arrogant and haughty — Sihao therefore nursed resentment in his heart.

units.zh: 後主奔鄴，就加太宰。
units.en: When the Later Lord fled to Ye, Pu was additionally made grand preceptor.
units.literal: When the Later Lord fled to Ye, Pu was additionally made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 二月己亥，以太傅、常山王演爲太師、錄尚書事，以太尉、長廣王湛爲大司馬、幷省錄尚書事，以尚書左僕射、平秦王歸彥爲司空，趙郡王叡爲尚書左僕射。
units.en: In the second month, on jihai, Prince Yan of Changshan, then grand tutor, was appointed grand preceptor and recorder of the Masters of Writing. Prince Zhan of Changguang, then grand commandant, became grand marshal and recorder of the Masters of Writing in the Bingzhou administration. Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, became minister of works, and Prince Rui of Zhaojun became left vice director.
units.literal: In the second month, on jihai, the Grand Tutor, Prince Yan of Changshan, was made Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing; the Grand Commandant, Prince Zhan of Changguang, was made Grand Marshal and Recorder of the Affairs of the Masters of Writing in Bing Province; the Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, was made Minister of Works; and Prince Rui of Zhaojun was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 皇建二年秋，天文告變，歸彥慮有後害，仍白孝昭，以王當咎。
units.en: In autumn of Huangjian 2, ominous celestial signs appeared. Guiyan feared future trouble and again told Emperor Xiaozhao that the prince was the one portended by the omen.
units.literal: In autumn of the second year of Huangjian, celestial signs announced change; Guiyan feared there would be later danger, and again told Xiaozhao that the prince was the one on whom blame would fall.

units.zh: 乃遣歸彥馳驛至晉陽宮殺之。
units.en: He therefore sent Guiyan by relay post to Jinyang Palace to kill him.
units.literal: He therefore sent Guiyan by relay horse to Jinyang Palace to kill him.

units.zh: 戊申，以常山王演爲大丞相、都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事，以大司馬、長廣王湛爲太傅、京畿大都督，以司徒段韶爲大將軍，以前司空、平陽王淹爲太尉，以司空、平秦王歸彥爲司徒，彭城王浟爲尚書令。
units.en: On the wushen day, Prince Yan of Changshan was appointed grand chief minister, commander of all armies, and recorder of the Masters of Writing. Prince Zhan of Changguang, grand marshal, became grand tutor and metropolitan commander of the capital region. Duan Shao, minister over the masses, became great general; Prince Yan of Pingyang, formerly minister of works, became grand commandant; Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, minister of works, became minister over the masses; and Prince You of Pengcheng became director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: On the wushen day, Prince Yan of Changshan was made grand chief minister, commander-in-chief of all armies at home and abroad, and recorder of the affairs of the Masters of Writing; Prince Zhan of Changguang, grand marshal, was made grand tutor and metropolitan commander of the capital region; Duan Shao, minister over the masses, was made great general; the former minister of works, Prince Yan of Pingyang, was made grand commandant; Prince Guiyan of Pingqin, minister of works, was made minister over the masses; and Prince You of Pengcheng was made director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 常山王憂悵，乃白太后誅其黨，時平秦王歸彥亦預謀焉。
units.en: Prince Yan of Changshan grew anxious and asked the empress dowager to execute that faction; Prince Guiyan of Pingqin was also involved in the plot.
units.literal: The Prince of Changshan became anxious and distressed, and so reported to the empress dowager that their party should be executed; at the time Prince Guiyan of Pingqin also took part in the plot.

units.zh: 孝昭皇帝演，字延安，神武皇帝第六子，文宣皇帝之母弟也。
units.en: Emperor Xiaozhao, whose personal name was Yan and style name Yan'an, was the sixth son of Emperor Shenwu and the full younger brother of Emperor Wenxuan.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaozhao Yan, styled Yan'an, was the sixth son of Emperor Shenwu and the younger brother of Emperor Wenxuan by the same mother.

units.zh: 大寧元年閏十二月癸卯，梓宮還鄴，上諡曰孝昭皇帝。
units.en: In the intercalary twelfth month of Daning 1, on guimao, his coffin was returned to Ye, and he was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao.
units.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month of the first year of Daning, on guimao, the imperial coffin returned to Ye, and the posthumous title Emperor Xiaozhao was presented.

units.zh: 魏元象元年，封常山郡公。
units.en: In the first year of the Yuanxiang era of Wei, he was made Duke of Changshan Commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Yuanxiang of Wei, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Changshan Commandery.

units.zh: 唯常山王至，內外肅然。
units.en: Only when the Prince of Changshan appeared did the palace fall silent and straighten itself.
units.literal: Only when the Prince of Changshan arrived would inside and outside become solemn and awestruck.

units.zh: 皇建元年八月壬午，皇帝即位於晉陽宣德殿，大赦，改乾明元年為皇建。
units.en: On the renwu day of the eighth month of the first year of Huangjian, the emperor ascended the throne in the Xuande Hall at Jinyang, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name from Qianming to Huangjian.
units.literal: On the renwu day of the eighth month of Huangjian year 1, the emperor ascended the throne in the Xuande Hall at Jinyang, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name from Qianming year 1 to Huangjian.

units.zh: 五年，除幷省尚書令。
units.en: In the fifth year he was made Chief Minister of the Secretariat for the combined provinces.
units.literal: In the fifth year, he was appointed Chief Minister of the Secretariat of the Joint Provinces.

units.zh: 八年，轉司空、錄尚書事。
units.en: In the eighth year he was made Minister of Works and Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the eighth year, he was transferred to Minister of Works and made Recorder of the Affairs of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 帝長於政術，剖斷咸盡其理，文宣歎重之。
units.en: The prince had a gift for statecraft; every ruling he handed down went to the heart of the matter, and Emperor Wenxuan marveled at him.
units.literal: The Emperor excelled in the art of governance; his analyses and judgments all exhaustively addressed the principles involved, and Wenxuan sighed in admiration and held him in high esteem.

units.zh: 幼而英特，早有大成之量，武明皇太后早所愛重。
units.en: Even as a boy he was remarkable, showing early promise of greatness, and Empress Dowager Wuming had cherished him from the start.
units.literal: From childhood he was outstanding; early on he showed the measure of great accomplishment, and Empress Dowager Wuming had loved and esteemed him from the first.

units.zh: 及文襄執政，遣中書侍郎李同軌就霸府為諸弟師。
units.en: Once Wenxiang took charge of the government, he dispatched Li Tonggui, Gentleman of the Secretariat, to the Overlord's residence to instruct his younger brothers.
units.literal: When Wenxiang came to hold power, he sent Secretariat Gentleman Li Tonggui to the Overlord's residence to serve as tutor to the younger brothers.

units.zh: 右丞相、長廣王湛研機測化，體道居宗，人雄之望，海內瞻仰，同胞共氣，家國所憑，可遣尚書左僕射、趙郡王叡喻旨，征王統茲大寶。
units.en: Prince Zhan of Changguang, right chancellor, understands hidden workings and change, embodies the Way, and stands foremost among the clan. The whole realm looks to him as a hero among men. Born of the same mother and sharing the same breath, he is the support of house and state. Send Prince Rui of Zhaojun, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, to convey my intent and summon him to take charge of the throne.
units.literal: The Right Chancellor, Prince Zhan of Changguang, studies subtle workings and fathoms transformation, embodies the Way and stands within the clan; as a hero among men, he is looked up to within the seas. Of the same womb and shared breath, he is one on whom house and state rely. The Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Prince Rui of Zhaojun, may be sent to explain the intent and summon the prince to govern this great treasure.

units.zh: 順成后本魏朝宗室，文宣欲帝離之，陰為帝廣求淑媛，望移其寵。
units.en: Empress Shuncheng came from the Wei imperial clan. Emperor Wenxuan wanted the prince to turn from her and secretly searched out worthy beauties for him, hoping to draw his heart elsewhere.
units.literal: Empress Shuncheng was originally of the imperial clan of Wei; Wenxuan wanted the Emperor to distance himself from her, and secretly sought fine ladies widely for the Emperor, hoping to shift his favor.

units.zh: 冬十一月辛亥，立妃元氏為皇后，世子百年為皇太子。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the eleventh month, Consort Yuan was installed as empress and the heir apparent Gao Bainian as crown prince.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the xinhai day, Consort Yuan was installed as empress and the heir apparent Bainian as crown prince.

units.zh: 豈幽顯之間，實有報復，將齊之基宇止在於斯，帝欲大之，天不許也？
